repo_evidence_read: research branch tree showing synthetic/tactical research workflows
warning: This is a gap audit, not a statement that all repo candidates are one promoted Digital Twin. If a current Twin field/mechanism was not directly verified, it is classified REALITY_UNKNOWN rather than inferred.

rows.reality_evidence: KEIRIN.JP officially publishes competition score as a recent-form strength summary.
rows.repo_evidence: Untouched S0 uses competition_score only; current PRE manifest allows timestamp-safe competition_score.
rows.gap: Formula/version provenance from public displayed score to regulatory score computation remains incomplete.
rows.action_candidate: Add source-version/timestamp provenance, not a new coefficient.

rows.reality_evidence: Entrant membership can change through inspection, participation stopping, cancellation and replacement.
rows.repo_evidence: Probability engine consumes active_car_numbers and fail-closes mismatches.
rows.gap: A static active list does not itself model scheduled->confirmed->scratched/replaced state transitions or their timestamps.
rows.action_candidate: Introduce explicit entrant-state lifecycle in a future engineering prespec; no sporting coefficient implied.

rows.twin_element: single ordered probability object / sequential PL projection
rows.reality_evidence: No official rule says placements are generated by PL conditional independence.
rows.repo_evidence: stage1_pl_ticket_probability_engine_v1.py derives ordered pairs/top3 by conditional normalization from winner probabilities.
rows.gap: Tie mass, DQ, abandonment, cancellation and dynamic tactical dependence are outside the simple unique-order PL assumption.
rows.action_candidate: Keep as transparent baseline; treat stage-wise mismatch as model-structure evidence, not Reality Truth.

rows.reality_evidence: Bet-type winning combinations are legally defined.
rows.repo_evidence: Stage1 engine maps sporting probabilities to 2shatan/2shahuku/3rentan/3renhuku/wide and frame markets without result/settlement access.
rows.gap: This is MARKET structure and must remain separate from sporting utility; settlement invalidation/refund state is not represented by ticket projection alone.
rows.action_candidate: Add settlement-state layer separately; do not feed market rules into Outcome Model.

rows.reality_evidence: Wide corresponds to the three unordered pairs among the ordered top3 outcome under current ticket semantics.
rows.repo_evidence: Stage1 engine explicitly checks wide catalog mass target 3.0.
rows.gap: Mathematical projection invariant, not a physical race mechanism.

rows.reality_evidence: Official/public style exists; S/B/nige/makuri/sashi/mark are pre-race historical/tactical summaries in current research source contracts.
rows.repo_evidence: Current PRE source manifest allows style/S/B/nige/makuri/sashi/mark candidates.
rows.gap: Historical propensity is not identical to realized race tactic. A one-dimensional style scalar already failed independent holdout and must not be treated as reality coefficient.
rows.action_candidate: Preserve raw provenance; any representation needs a new prespec and untouched future split.

rows.reality_evidence: No objective official pre-race line-formation source was verified; prior KDreams narabi source was classified human forecast.
rows.repo_evidence: Current PRE manifest allows line_snapshot only if PRE_INTERFACE compliant.
rows.gap: Schema allowance can be mistaken for objective reality support.
rows.action_candidate: Keep unavailable/UNKNOWN until objective source and timestamp semantics are verified; never substitute human prediction.

rows.reality_evidence: Current official circumference exists; detailed current nationwide geometry registry not yet verified.
rows.repo_evidence: Current PRE manifest includes bank_length candidate.
rows.gap: Circumference alone omits straight length, cant/curve geometry and environmental enclosure where those matter.
rows.action_candidate: Build official venue-physics registry first; then test small prespecified interactions.

rows.reality_evidence: Program progression is explicitly stage/day dependent and uses prior finishes.
rows.repo_evidence: Current PRE manifest includes race_stage candidate.
rows.gap: S0 does not use stage, and evaluation claims may ignore program-selection path dependence.
rows.action_candidate: First use as population/stratification variable; feature experiment only under separate prespec.

rows.repo_evidence: No verified current S0 weather input in audited artifacts.
rows.gap: Venue-to-station mapping, publication lag, observation version and missingness are not frozen.
rows.action_candidate: Create point-in-time weather-source contract before any model use.

rows.reality_evidence: Gear ratio, bicycle identity and inspection/change are official operational state.
rows.repo_evidence: Not present in untouched S0; current generic PRE manifest did not list gear in allowed candidate fields.
rows.gap: Potential reality state missing from current baseline/Twin object and timestamp changes near race create stale-value risk.
rows.action_candidate: Audit historical availability and effective timestamp before extending PRE object.

rows.twin_element: tie / DQ / abandonment / cancellation result-state ontology
rows.reality_evidence: All are explicit official states affecting judging, progression or settlement.
rows.repo_evidence: Research parsers commonly fail-close ambiguous ordered labels; PL engine assumes unique active ordering.
rows.gap: Fail-closing is scientifically safe for a benchmark but does not make the real state disappear.
rows.action_candidate: Add explicit non-standard-result ontology at Twin/result-integrity layer; keep benchmark exclusion reason codes.

rows.reality_evidence: Program formation uses ability, style, region, results and advancement rules.
rows.repo_evidence: Current audited probability baseline does not explicitly model selection process.
rows.gap: Digital Twin can simulate race outcomes while missing the upstream mechanism that determines who meets whom and in what stage.
rows.action_candidate: Represent program context/selection state before attempting broad generalization; not necessarily as a predictive coefficient.

rows.reality_evidence: No synthetic planted coefficient/mechanism is Reality Truth by itself.
rows.repo_evidence: Research branch contains explicitly named synthetic/tactical workflows; exact current planted-mechanism bodies were not promoted in this audit.
rows.gap: Risk of confusing protocol-falsification machinery with empirical sport mechanism.
rows.action_candidate: Keep synthetic lineage labels and provenance hard-separated from official Reality KB.
